# `smelt.prompt_bar.bottom`

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Availability:** Terminal UI only; raises in headless mode.

The rule below the prompt, empty by default. Register named sources with `smelt.prompt_bar.bottom.add(name, handler)`. `add` returns a `Reg` that removes the source. UiHost-only.

## `smelt.prompt_bar.bottom.add`

```lua
fun(name: string, handler: fun(): smelt.bar.Item[]?): smelt.Reg
```

Types: [`smelt.bar.Item`](types.md#smeltbaritem), [`smelt.Reg`](types.md#smeltreg)

Add a named source of items to the rule of the bar below the prompt. It has
no built-in sources, so the rule stays plain until a plugin adds one. Same
contract as `smelt.prompt_bar.top.add`.

## `smelt.prompt_bar.bottom.invalidate`

```lua
fun()
```

Repaint after plugin-owned state changes that are not represented by a
built-in signal. Adding, replacing, and removing sources invalidates
automatically.

## `smelt.prompt_bar.bottom.remove`

```lua
fun(name: string)
```

Remove every source named `name` from the bar below the prompt.
